title: Grants Payments Data Analyst
full_description: Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world. With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research. Make an Impact as a Grants Payments Data Analyst at Worldwide As a Grants Payments Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how clinical site payments are forecasted and reported. Your work will help bring together critical financial and operational data, supporting accurate forecasting and informed decision-making across clinical studies. In this role, you'll take ownership of forecasting models used outside of Medidata Payments, driving ongoing enhancements and ensuring alignment with broader payment forecasting processes. You’ll collaborate with teams across Revenue Recognition, Clinical Payments, Investigator Grants Payments, Project Analysis, and Clinical Operations to develop efficient, audit-ready forecasting solutions. Your expertise will help deliver accurate client-facing financial forecasts, support compliance with financial reporting requirements, and contribute to the successful management and reconciliation of clinical site payments throughout the study lifecycle. Where You'll Work This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones. Travel for this role is remote-based and may be required only as specified by business needs. What You'll Do Develop, maintain, and continuously improve forecasting models used outside of Medidata Payments. Partner with Central Planning and Clinical Operations teams to gather and analyze site and patient enrollment actuals and forecasts. Integrate forecasting outputs with Medidata Payments forecasts to support end-to-end clinical site payment planning. Collaborate with Revenue Recognition teams to ensure forecasting processes meet financial audit and compliance requirements. Create client-ready forecasting reports and deliverables in accordance with sponsor contractual requirements. Analyze forecast performance, budget utilization, and plan-versus-actual results to identify trends and risks. Communicate over- and under-forecast variances to Project Analysts and Global Project Leads, enabling timely corrective action. Support study closeout activities through final payment reconciliations and preparation of client-ready financial reports. Contribute to process development and continuous improvement initiatives related to clinical site payment forecasting and reporting. What You'll Bring Bachelor's degree and 2–5 years of finance experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data. Experience working with Excel, databases, and accounting systems. Understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition standards. Knowledge of clinical site payment processes and forecasting methodologies. Ability to influence, collaborate, and challenge stakeholders constructively across cross-functional teams. Experience supporting audit requirements, financial reporting, and compliance-related activities. Proficiency in English. Discover the Difference We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit http://www.worldwide.com/careers , or connect with us on LinkedIn .

full_description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Summary At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We are seeking a Data Analyst – Analytics Engineering & AI to support the development of modern enterprise analytics capabilities and help accelerate the evolution of digital analytics toward AI-supported insights. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Analytics & Insights , the Data Analyst will work at the intersection of business analytics, data visualization, analytics engineering, data modeling, and AI-enabled analytics . This role will partner with business stakeholders, senior analysts, data engineers, architects, and product teams to transform business questions into trusted datasets, analytical models, dashboards, reports, and actionable insights. The Data Analyst will also contribute to the development of an AI-ready analytics foundation by helping organize business metrics, metadata, data relationships, definitions, and analytical datasets so they can be consistently used across dashboards, self-service analytics, conversational analytics, and emerging AI applications. The ideal candidate is analytically curious, technically capable, comfortable working with complex data, and interested in developing skills across analytics engineering, semantic modeling, and AI-enabled analytics. Major Job Duties And Responsibilities Partner with business stakeholders and senior analytics team members to understand business questions, reporting requirements, KPIs, and analytical needs. Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, anomalies, and drivers of business performance. Develop recurring and ad hoc analyses supporting commercial, customer, digital, operational, and strategic initiatives. Build and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualizations that provide clear and actionable insights to business stakeholders. Write and maintain SQL queries and data transformations used to create analytical datasets and support reporting and analysis. Assist in developing reusable analytical datasets and data models that improve consistency and reduce duplicated reporting logic. Support the development and maintenance of a trusted semantic analytics layer, including business definitions, KPIs, dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and relationships. Work with senior analysts and business stakeholders to document and validate metric definitions and ensure consistent interpretation across analytical products. Perform data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to identify inconsistencies, missing data, or unexpected results. Investigate data-quality and reporting issues and partner with analytics engineering and data engineering teams to identify root causes. Support the creation and maintenance of documentation covering data sources, transformations, metric calculations, business rules, assumptions, and analytical logic. Assist with ETL/ELT and analytics engineering activities, including data transformations, testing, validation, and maintenance of curated analytical datasets. Use Python or similar analytical technologies for data preparation, automation, exploratory analysis, validation, and analytical workflows as appropriate. Support customer, product, digital, marketing, commercial, and operational analytics initiatives through data exploration and performance measurement. Assist with experimentation, segmentation, funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, KPI tracking, forecasting, and other analytical methodologies as needed. Work with senior team members to identify opportunities to automate manual reports, repetitive analysis, and data-preparation processes. Support the transition from traditional reporting toward more self-service, proactive, and AI-enabled analytical experiences. Participate in the development and testing of conversational analytics, natural-language querying, AI-generated insights, semantic search, and other emerging analytical capabilities. Validate AI-generated analytical outputs by comparing responses against trusted datasets, established metrics, source systems, and documented business rules. Help organize metadata, business definitions, and semantic context so AI-enabled analytics solutions can more accurately interpret enterprise data. Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, security, product, and governance teams to ensure analytical solutions follow organizational standards. Participate in peer reviews, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement of analytics products and processes. Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders using effective visualizations, summaries, and recommendations. Continuously develop knowledge of modern analytics, data engineering, semantic technologies, cloud data platforms, generative AI, and emerging analytical practices. QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience And Certifications) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline. Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered. Advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are beneficial but not required. 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering, data science, or a related discipline. Experience working with structured datasets and translating business questions into analytical outputs. Experience developing dashboards, reports, analyses, or analytical datasets in a business environment. Experience working with relational databases, cloud data warehouses, or enterprise analytical platforms. Exposure to data modeling, dimensional modeling, semantic models, metrics layers, or curated analytical datasets is preferred. Experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, Teradata, Hadoop, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or similar technologies is beneficial. Experience with digital analytics technologies such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics is beneficial. Exposure to enterprise systems such as SAP, ERP, CRM, digital commerce, marketing, customer, or operational platforms is preferred. Exposure to generative AI, conversational analytics, natural-language querying, semantic search, machine learning, or AI-enabled analytics is beneficial Technical Skills Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical querying. Working knowledge of Python or another analytical programming language for data manipulation, automation, analysis, or validation. Experience with visualization and business intelligence technologies such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools. Understanding of data structures, relational databases, analytical datasets, and basic data modeling concepts. Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and modern data-transformation workflows. Understanding of data-quality principles, including validation, reconciliation, completeness, consistency, and accuracy. Familiarity with version control, documentation, testing, or collaborative software/data development practices is beneficial. Basic understanding of cloud data architectures and modern data warehouse technologies. Interest in or exposure to generative AI, large language models, semantic search, embeddings, knowledge models, or AI agents is preferred. Ability to understand how business definitions, metadata, data relationships, and metric calculations affect analytics and AI-generated insights. Analytics & Ai Semantic Engineering Capabilities The Data Analyst will have the opportunity to develop capabilities beyond traditional reporting and contribute to the semantic and analytical foundation supporting next-generation analytics. Key responsibilities may include: Supporting the definition and maintenance of reusable business metrics and KPIs. Helping document business terminology and map business concepts to enterprise data. Assisting in defining relationships between customers, products, channels, transactions, campaigns, digital interactions, and other business entities. Building analytical datasets that can be reused across dashboards, reports, analyses, and AI-enabled applications. Helping identify differences between business terminology and source-system definitions. Contributing metadata, definitions, descriptions, and contextual information that improve self-service and AI-enabled analytics. Testing natural-language questions against analytical datasets and identifying cases where AI-generated responses are inaccurate or ambiguous. Validating AI-generated analytical responses against trusted data and established business definitions. Supporting data and semantic quality controls that improve accuracy, consistency, explainability, and trust. Developing an understanding of how governed enterprise data can support AI agents and conversational analytical experiences. CORE COMPETENCIES Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Curiosity and willingness to investigate unfamiliar data and business problems. Ability to translate data into clear observations and business insights. Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical accuracy. Ability to communicate findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across analytics, engineering, product, technology, and business teams. Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and seek deeper understanding of business problems. Strong documentation and organizational skills. Commitment to continuous learning and development across analytics, data engineering, and AI technologies.

title: Principal Survey Data Analyst

Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy. At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in “Solving the Unsolvable” by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

title: Data Scientist, Response Evaluation
skills: Python, Pandas, NumPy, PyTorch, Machine Learning, GCP, Statistics
full_description: Data Scientist, Response EvaluationJob DescriptionAbout Uplevyl Uplevyl builds AI-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women. Our products include UpGenie (our domain-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform) and UpSocial (a social platform for women). We work with mission-driven partners to turn complex, high-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact. We hold a simple conviction: in high-stakes domains like rights, law and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent. AI is reshaping how the world learns, works and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left behind. We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper. That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one. About the Role The Data Scientist, Response Evaluation, owns the math underneath UpGenie. UpGenie answers high-stakes questions about rights, law and safety, and you will decide how it scores and ranks evidence, how we measure whether an answer is right, how confident the system needs to be before it answers, and how we balance accuracy against latency and cost. The answer to a rights question can change at every level of government: federal law, the 50 states and DC, and about 90,000 local governments, which the US Census Bureau counts as counties, cities, towns, and school and special districts. Our system retrieves and ranks evidence across federal, state and local law in several domains, and our evaluation results drive real product decisions. You will make sure those decisions rest on things we can reason about: scoring functions whose behavior we understand, metrics with confidence intervals, thresholds with stated guarantees, and experiments with enough power to separate signal from noise. The role suits someone trained in mathematics, statistics or a quantitative science who has turned that training into working software. You can derive an estimator and prove its properties, then implement it, test it on real data and ship it. You will ship to production from your first weeks, with real users and real partners depending on what you build. What You’ll Own 1. Ranking and Retrieval Math The scoring functions behind search and ranking: lexical scoring, embedding similarity, hybrid score fusion, learning-to-rank, re-ranking and diversity. You will know the geometry of the embedding spaces we use and where it breaks down. 2. Evaluation Statistics Metric design, sampling plans, confidence intervals, significance and power, inter-annotator agreement, and correction for noisy automated judges. Every number we report comes with its uncertainty. 3. Calibration and Abstention Confidence scores that mean what they say. You will calibrate model scores, set abstention and escalation rules with explicit error guarantees, and decide when the system should ask a follow-up question instead of answering. 4. Optimization and Model Improvement Objectives and loss functions for fine-tuning and ranking models, principled hyperparameter and prompt search, and a clear model of the trade-off between accuracy, latency and cost, so product decisions rest on numbers. 5. Monitoring and Data Quality Catch quality changes as they happen: shifts in query and document distributions, embedding drift across model versions, change-points in production metrics, and duplicate or near-duplicate content at scale. 6. Decision Support Short, precise analyses that product, engineering and partners can act on. Lead with the answer, show the math, then say it in plain English, including what the data does not support. No false precision: 92.37% on 150 cases is not a finding. Who We’re Looking For We hire across levels. Depth of understanding and results you can show matter more than titles or years of experience. We will ask you to solve problems and build during our process, because we have learned that knowing the math and applying it to messy, real systems are different skills. Deep Mathematical Foundations Probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization at the level of derivations and proofs, not just library calls. You can tell when an assumption is doing the real work in an argument. You Ship Working Code You are fluent in Python with NumPy, SciPy and pandas, and you work in PyTorch or JAX. Your analyses are reproducible and tested, and they run in production, not only in a notebook. Statistical Judgment You know when a difference is noise. You design the experiment before you run it, and you report uncertainty by default. Rigor In our domain, a confident wrong answer can harm someone. You test before you claim, you measure before you optimize, and you flag what you are unsure about. You keep facts, inferences and assumptions separate. High Agency You unblock yourself. Given an ambiguous problem with no owner in sight, you scope it, propose an approach and build. A Clear Communicator You can explain a confidence interval to a non-technical partner and defend a modeling choice to a senior researcher, in plain words either way. Even Better If You have a graduate degree or research experience in mathematics, statistics, theoretical computer science, physics or a related field. You have worked on information retrieval, ranking, recommender systems or search quality. You have built evaluation, experimentation or A/B testing infrastructure for machine learning systems. You have used Bayesian methods, causal inference, conformal prediction or sequential testing on real problems. You have worked with Vertex AI, GCP or comparable cloud ML stacks. You have public work we can look at: papers, open source, technical writing or competition results. Before You Apply We want to be direct about what this is. This is a high-bar role on a small team, with real ownership and high expectations. Because our products work in high-stakes domains, we value rigor over shortcuts. Speed matters, but so does knowing when an elegant model or a plausible-looking result needs a closer look. If you want a pure research role, or a defined lane with clearly separated responsibilities, this is not the right fit, and that is fine. If you want to bring mathematical rigor to a system people depend on, we want to hear from you. Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation. How We Work at Uplevyl We finish what we start, and we do it well. We follow through on what we say we’ll do, and we care about the difference our work makes. We listen before we decide. Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way, by consistently showing up for people. We move with ownership and urgency. We don’t wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality. We are better together than alone. We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create. full_description: Join our Business Management team within the Equity Derivatives and Trading (EDT) Division supporting our Commodities and Global Markets. full_description: Job Opening: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI) Trainer Company: Analytix Learning Academy Location: Hyderabad, Telangana Work Mode: Classroom / Online / Hybrid (as applicable) Employment Type: Full-time / Contract (as applicable) Experience: 2–5+ years of relevant industry or hands-on project experience Open Positions: 1 About Analytix Learning Academy Analytix Learning Academy offers practical, industry-oriented training programmes in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. We are seeking a passionate and technically strong Data Analytics & BI Trainer to train students and graduates in Excel, SQL, Python for analytics, statistics, Power BI, data modelling, dashboards and AI-enabled business intelligence. The ideal candidate should combine hands-on analytics expertise with the ability to teach concepts clearly, demonstrate real business use cases and mentor students through practical projects. Job Summary The trainer will deliver the Analytics Foundation stage of our Applied Data Science & AI Engineer programme, covering business problem-solving, Excel, statistics, SQL, Python-based data analysis, AI-assisted development, Power BI, DAX, data modelling, AI in BI and introductory Generative AI and Agentic AI applications for analytics. The role involves instructor-led training, live demonstrations, practical assignments, project mentoring, assessments and technical interview preparation. Key Responsibilities1. Technical Training & Curriculum Delivery Teach Excel fundamentals, advanced formulas, lookup functions, PivotTables, Power Query and dashboard development. Explain business problem framing, KPI identification, data interpretation and analytical thinking. Deliver statistics and probability sessions covering descriptive statistics, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression and A/B testing. Teach SQL using MySQL or PostgreSQL, including querying, filtering, joins, aggregation, subqueries, CTEs and window functions. Train students in Python for data analysis, including fundamentals, functions, data structures, NumPy, Pandas, APIs and data cleaning. Teach exploratory data analysis (EDA), data quality validation, outlier analysis and data visualisation. Deliver Power BI training covering data connections, Power Query, ETL, star schema, relationships, DAX, calculated columns, measures and advanced DAX. Explain dashboard design, interactive reports, drill-through, tooltips, bookmarks, row-level security and data storytelling. Introduce Power BI Service, publishing, scheduled refresh, workspaces and performance optimisation. Demonstrate AI-assisted Excel, SQL and DAX development using appropriate AI tools. Introduce AI in BI, forecasting, anomaly detection, AI-assisted reporting and Generative AI concepts. Demonstrate introductory RAG and Agentic AI workflows for analytics, including automated reporting and business insight summaries. 2. Practical Training & Real-World Projects Conduct live demonstrations, hands-on labs and guided exercises using business datasets. Create industry-oriented assignments based on sales, finance, HR, marketing, banking and operations. Mentor students through module-wise mini projects, including: Excel sales performance dashboard and business recommendations. SQL analysis of banking or customer transaction data. Python-based EDA and data quality reporting. Power BI HR attrition dashboard and retention recommendations. AI-assisted sales reporting and insight automation. Guide students in converting business requirements into KPIs, analytical questions and dashboard specifications. Teach students to interpret results, identify trends and communicate actionable recommendations. Review project documentation, dashboards and presentations. 3. Student Assessment & Mentoring Prepare daily practice tasks and module-wise assignments. Conduct weekly examinations, practical assessments and timed SQL or analytics tests. Conduct technical mock interviews and assess students' understanding of concepts. Evaluate mini projects and capstone projects using structured assessment rubrics. Provide individual feedback, additional practice and remediation where required. Monitor attendance, assignment completion, assessment scores and overall student progress. Help learners develop portfolio-ready projects and prepare for Data Analyst and BI Analyst interviews. 4. Curriculum Development & Academic Coordination Prepare lesson plans, presentations, datasets, practical exercises, assignments and assessment materials. Follow the approved curriculum and maintain training schedules. Develop case studies based on realistic business problems and industry scenarios. Coordinate with other trainers to ensure a smooth transition from analytics foundations to Data Science and AI Engineering. Work with academic and placement teams to support student readiness. Incorporate relevant developments in Power BI, analytics automation and AI-assisted business intelligence. Required Technical Skills Must-have skills Advanced Excel, including formulas, PivotTables and Power Query. SQL using MySQL or PostgreSQL. Statistics and probability for business analytics. Python for data analysis, including Pandas, NumPy and data visualisation. Power BI Desktop, Power Query, data modelling and DAX. Dashboard development, KPI reporting and data storytelling. Hands-on analytical problem-solving using real or representative business datasets. Preferred additional skills Power BI Service, workspace management, scheduled refresh and row-level security. Exposure to Tableau or other BI platforms. AI-assisted analytics using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot. Basic understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and Agentic AI workflows. Familiarity with tools such as n8n, BigQuery, dbt or Microsoft Fabric. Experience using Git/GitHub for project documentation and portfolio development. Educational Qualifications B.E./B.Tech, MCA, M.Sc., MBA Analytics or a related qualification preferred. Relevant certifications in Microsoft Power BI, analytics or related technologies are an advantage. Strong practical experience and demonstrable projects will be valued. Experience Requirements Demonstrable hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, reporting or related roles. Experience with business dashboards, SQL analysis and analytical reporting. Prior experience in technical training, mentoring, corporate training or academic instruction is preferred. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their technical skills through a practical assessment. Preferred Candidate Profile Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to explain technical and statistical concepts to beginners. Strong analytical thinking and business problem-solving skills. Comfortable managing classroom sessions and supporting individual learners. Patient, approachable and committed to student development. Able to connect technical concepts with real business decisions. Performance Expectations Complete assigned modules within the agreed training schedule. Deliver hands-on practical sessions and industry-oriented case studies. Conduct regular assessments and provide timely feedback. Ensure students complete module-wise assignments, mini projects and capstone milestones. Support student portfolios, mock interviews and job readiness. How to Apply Interested candidates may share their updated resume, LinkedIn profile and sample dashboards or project portfolio.
